full_name: Scarlett Cornelissen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Social Sciences Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow Stellenbosch University (South Africa)
bio: Scarlett Cornelissen is a professor in the Department of Political Science at Stellenbosch University in South Africa. She works in the field of international relations, addressing broader questions of Africa’s place in the contemporary international system and more specific topics related to the political economy of Africa’s relations with East Asia.
